method.workload: One warmed four-call strictly growing JFK PCM/Partial trace per trial, order serial/batch/batch/serial; same process and lane, no AllocsPerRun or GOMAXPROCS changes.
method.baseline: Original serial LogitsRowsInto behavior at 2086220, selected with the archived head-batch experiment switch; encoder reuse is inactive for this short clip.
method.counters: runtime.ReadMemStats immediately before and after the trace, GOMAXPROCS=16; MemProfileRate=1 enabled only after loading and warming the model.
method.stack_scope: Allocation profile deltas bracket the trace plus two forced GCs needed to publish profile records. Background worker/runtime allocations during profile publication may appear in stack deltas but not in the narrower measured trace totals. Stack counts are diagnostic, not exact attribution of the measured byte totals.
method.finding: Both serial and batched variants allocate existing runtime channel-wait records at runtime.acquireSudog -> runtime.chanrecv -> qwen3lm.(*workerPool).loop. The serial path also shows runtime timer-heap growth. The batching change adds no numeric storage; neither variant is universally allocation-free at 16 Ps.
method.go_sources: testing/benchmark.go B.loopSlowPath stops counters before returning false, excluding deferred Close. testing/allocs.go forces GOMAXPROCS=1 and integer-divides allocation totals. runtime/proc.go acquireSudog allocates on empty per-P and central caches; runtime/mgc.go clearpools clears only the central sudog cache.
method.reproduce: Apply head-batch-experiment.patch and then head-batch-allocation-experiment.patch to an isolated final checkout. Build qwen3asr test binary with project-env, GOEXPERIMENT=simd, CGO_ENABLED=0. Run from qwen3asr with GOMAXPROCS=16, GOPHONIC_MODELS, STT_HEAD_ALLOCS=/tmp/allocations.json and -test.run ^TestCPUHeadAllocationTrace$.
